info.title: Tender Intelligence API
info.description: Multi-tenant tender (RFP/bid) ingestion, structured extraction, review, historical knowledge search, proposal drafting and DOCX/XLSX export. All endpoints except /auth/* and /health* require a Bearer access token; every record is scoped to the caller's organization (tenant).

post.description: Revoke a refresh token (the short-lived access token simply expires).
Onboard a user into the administrator's organization (tenant).

patch.description: Change a user's role and/or activate/deactivate the account.

schema.title: Response List Tender Cases Tender Cases Get

get.description: Lifecycle states the current user may move this case to manually.

All documents of the case with their processing status.

ZIP uploads appear as a parent record; extracted files reference it via
``parent_document_id``. Poll this endpoint to follow processing.

schema.title: Response List Documents Tender Cases  Tender Case Id  Documents Get

post.description:
Upload one or more PDF, DOCX, XLSX or ZIP files.

Files are stored immediately and processed asynchronously; ZIP archives
are unpacked by the worker into child documents of the same case.

schema.title: Response Upload Documents Tender Cases  Tender Case Id  Documents Post

delete.description:
Delete a document (and, for a ZIP archive, its extracted files).

Already extracted requirements keep their textual citation.

post.description: Re-queue a document (e.g. after a failure or a worker outage).

(Re-)run structured extraction over the case's processed documents.

Runs automatically when document processing finishes; this endpoint lets
an editor trigger it again. Reviewed items are preserved.

schema.title: Response List Case Requirements Tender Cases  Case Id  Requirements Get

post.description: Manually add a requirement the extraction missed (editor/reviewer/admin).

get.description:
Typed extraction schema: deadlines, lots, mandatory requirements,
evaluation criteria, required evidence and document references - each
with its source citation, confidence and review status.

patch.description:
Correct extracted fields and/or record a review decision.

The original extracted text is never overwritten: ``requirement`` (or
``corrected_requirement``) is stored as the correction.

get.description: Historical snippets most similar to this requirement (tenant-isolated).

Sections, open-issue checklist, extracted requirements and approval
readiness in one payload. Creates default sections on first access.

post.description:
Generate draft text for a section from extracted requirements and
matched historical snippets (via the provider-agnostic LLM interface).
The section stays in ``draft`` status for human editing.

Build the open-issue checklist from extracted requirements:
evidence to collect, deadlines to confirm, and outstanding reviews.
Existing issues with the same title are not duplicated.

Approver sign-off. Requires every section complete, all issues
resolved and every extracted requirement reviewed.

get.description: Formatted proposal (cover page, contents, sections, compliance appendix).

Workbook: Summary, Compliance Matrix, Lots, Positions, Deadlines,
Evidence and Open Issues.

schema.title: Response List Historical Documents Knowledge Base Documents Get

post.description:
Upload past tenders/bids (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ZIP) for indexing.

``outcome`` records the win/loss/completion status used in search results.

schema.title: Response Upload Historical Documents Knowledge Base Documents Post

patch.description: Update record type, outcome (won/lost/...) or notes after the fact.

delete.description:
Delete a historical record, its chunks/vectors and stored files.

Deleting a ZIP archive also deletes the documents extracted from it.

post.description:
Tenant-isolated semantic search over indexed historical documents.

Every hit carries its source reference (document name, page, paragraph/row).

requirement_ids.title: Requirement Ids
requirement_ids.description: Requirements to address; defaults to all non-rejected mandatory ones.

replace.title: Replace
replace.description: Replace instead of appending to current content.

RequirementCreate.title: RequirementCreate
RequirementCreate.description: Manually add a requirement the extraction missed.

source_excerpt.title: Source Excerpt
source_excerpt.description: Original source paragraph text for side-by-side review.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Quality flags: low_confidence, missing_source, missing_location, corrected.
